m.x:
Converts an ArrayBuffer into a base64 string.

The resulting string can optionally be a data uri if the `mediaType` argument is provided.

See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/Data_URIs for more details.

p.x: An optional media type, i.e. `audio/ogg` or `image/jpeg`. If included the resulting string will be a data URI.

m.x: Converts a base64 string, either with or without a data uri, into an Array Buffer.

p.x: The base64 string to be decoded. Can optionally contain a data URI header, which will be stripped out prior to decoding.

r.x: An ArrayBuffer decoded from the base64 data.
